limitations: This tested the HR hiring SOP only up to JD, then the human JD review. It is JD -> human review, NOT recruitment-completed; no candidate, interview, offer or hire occurred.
No real personnel data and no real hiring; the JD is a draft awaiting human approval.
A generic task from an uploaded SourceManifest is still unsupported as an ordinary task; the retry/ordinary path was exercised on ordinary tasks, not on an uploaded source manifest.
write_report stores a tenant-local file that is not exposed by a downloadable artifact registry; the accepted deliverable is the full inline answer rendered in the UI.
Older negative/edge cases were verified offline, not on the live provider.

Free providers are flaky: Nvidia returned 503 and one DOTS response carried inconsistent reasoning/completion usage that the strict parser refused. The parser was not loosened and usage was not invented.
The retry fix changes ordinary retry semantics on purpose: owned work stays owned. This is covered by a focused integration test and the full suite.
evidence: All raw receipts and screenshots are under .orchestra/hr-ui-acceptance-2026-10-18/ and .orchestra/hr-ui-sop-2026-10-18/ (local, gitignored, not published).
